text.text_excerpt: I stayed here for a weekend staycation (as I'm a local) and really enjoyed it. The location really is phenomenal - you're in the heart of the quarter and can walk to lots of great places (Jackson square, Cafe Du Monde, Crescent City Brewhouse, Pat O'Briens). The staff is very friendly and courteous. The rooms aren't that impressive - they're a little small and feel generic - but the bed is very comfortable. The rooftop pool is on the small side but unlike most rooftop pool bars it isn't open to non-guests so it wasn't too crowded when I visited. Their website hyped the rooftop views but they're not nearly as impressive as you'd hope - the hotel is surrounded by buildings that obscure it. ...

Love this location (close to Bourbon St., Jackson Square, St. Charles Streetcar), the rooms, the decor, the staff. Really, you don't get much better than this. It helps that we are Omni Select members, and received turn-down service at night and complimentary beverages (coffee, tea, juice, etc.) in the morning. They have a beautiful observation deck that gives gorgeous views of the whole French Quarter and water front. The have a pool and fitness center that look well-maintained and were easily accessible. I stayed here for a momentous birthday celebration Tuesday 12/4/12 through Friday 12/7/12. My first choice in hotels after doing online research was the Royal Sonesta and I was so disappointed when they did not have one room in the entire place for Wed 12/5. Omni was my second choice and some odd reviews about cleanliness and small, worn rooms worried me. I had nothing to worry about. I have no complaints about this hotel at all. It is well appointed and in the middle of it all without being noisy. We received good service from everyone we encountered.
